shortDescription.default: Web Agent for SharePoint — document upload and AI assistant web part for SharePoint and Microsoft Teams.

longDescription.default: Web Agent for SharePoint is a SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solution packaged as web-agent-for-sharepoint.sppkg. It contains a single client-side web part (`DocumentAiWebPart`) for SharePoint pages (including full-page apps) and Teams-capable hosts where supported. The web part provides an AI-powered document upload assistant that reads document contents, suggests metadata and upload locations, and surfaces guidance text configured via the web part properties. The package also includes a custom property pane password input control used to configure the Azure OpenAI API key.

features.title: Web Agent for SharePoint
features.description: Activates the Web Agent for SharePoint client-side web part and supporting custom property pane control.
